# Draft:The War Zone (website)

----
}}
The War Zone is an American online publication focused on military affairs, defense technology, aviation, and national security. The site was founded in 2016 by defense journalist Tyler Rogoway. The War Zone has been cited by other media outlets for its coverage of military aviation, emerging defense technologies, and open-source analysis of defense-related events, and has been listed by Reuters among news organisations covering the U.S. Department of Defense.
History
The War Zone was launched in 2016 as a specialist defense vertical within The Drive, an automotive and culture website. The section was created to provide focused coverage of military aviation, naval affairs, space, and defense technology, expanding beyond The Drive’s original automotive remit.
In 2024, industry media reported on the site’s relaunch as a standalone defense news website at TWZ.com, while remaining editorially linked to The Drive.
